question: What is attained by the one who has internalized all principles and reached emission?
premises: The agent has internalized infinite principles from ka to kṣa on all sides.
That agent has attained emission while remaining in an unchanged state.
Four life-giving powers are attained in that condition.
inference: Therefore the one who has internalized all principles and attained emission in an unchanged state obtains the four life-giving powers.
uncertainties: The 'four life-giving powers' are not named explicitly in this verse.
plain_english: By the one who has internalized the infinite principles from ka to kṣa on all sides, whose state remains unchanged after attaining emission, the four life-giving powers are attained.
